notes: The second waw takes *also* under rule 51; a waw is present, so the word is not added.
*make ... to cease* is split as light verb plus complement and heads on *cease* (rule 44), the unit discontinuous around the object phrase under rule 25.
מְקַדְשֵׁי → *holy places* heads on *holy* by rule 31's subtraction, as רָעֵי → *the worst* and עַזִּים → *of the strong* take their supplied *the*s under rules 46 and 15.
